prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation into the trapezius region, along with low back pain and stiffness that worsened over the following days. Cervical and lumbar range of motion was restricted, with palpable muscle guarding and tenderness over the paraspinal musculature. Neurological examination showed no focal deficits, and imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings.

Diagnoses were cervical strain and lumbar strain, both consistent with soft tissue injury from the collision. The patient completed a course of 28 visits consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Pain scores and range of motion improved steadily across the course of care, and the patient reported substantial reduction in daily functional limitations. At the most recent evaluation, residual stiffness remained with lifting and prolonged sitting, though the patient was progressing toward discharge with a independent home exercise program. Continued activity modification and ergonomic adjustments were recommended.
